incentives.name: Sales and use tax exemption for data processing services centers
incentives.law: House Bill 67 (2010), signed March 5, 2010; expanded in 2011 to cover uninterruptible power, heating, cooling and air quality equipment
incentives.what: Exempts computer and related equipment bought by qualifying data centers (over $2M a year in computing equipment, at least $5M capital cost, Wyoming Business Council job certification). Does not cover construction, property tax or electricity sales tax.
incentives.value_known: Data centers that reported logged more than $166M in savings; a 2021 state report cited at least $124.3M (underreported; only 3 of 10 responded).

dockets.utility: Black Hills Energy (Cheyenne Light, Fuel and Power)
dockets.what: Large Power Contract Service (LPCS) tariff for new loads of 13 MW or more, approved July 2016; basis for negotiated service agreements with Microsoft, Meta and Google data centers

dockets.utility: Black Hills Energy (Cheyenne Light, Fuel and Power)
dockets.what: Generation reservation agreement (April 22, 2026, amended July 2026) with a prospective customer building a 1.8 GW data center under the LPCS tariff; $285M refundable advances by June 30, 2026, raised to $377M (later $399M per Oct 2026 release); later identified as Google

dockets.utility: Black Hills Energy (Cheyenne Light, Fuel and Power)
dockets.what: Large Power Contract Services Agreement and Generation Facilities Agreement with Google, effective Sept 30, 2026, through 2048: up to 590 MW grid service (564 MW new gas generation at Cheyenne Prairie Generating Station, $1.8B investment 2027-2029) plus about 2.1 GW third-party resources via private microgrid

dockets.utility: Black Hills Energy (Cheyenne Light, Fuel and Power)
dockets.what: Robinson substation Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (supports the Google project)

dockets.utility: Black Hills Energy (Cheyenne Light, Fuel and Power)
dockets.what: Large Customer Transmission Cost Adjustment Mechanism (LCTCAM)

dockets.utility: Black Hills Energy (Cheyenne Light, Fuel and Power)
dockets.what: South Cheyenne Transmission Expansion CPCN; a further Wyoming transmission expansion CPCN to be filed Q4 2026

dockets.regulator: Wyoming Industrial Siting Council / Wyoming DEQ Air Quality Division
dockets.what: Industrial siting permit (filed July 2026) and air quality permit (approved Aug 2026) for the Cheyenne Prairie Generating Station expansion serving the Google data center

laws_and_bills.name: House Bill 155 (2026 budget session), data center sales tax exemption changes
laws_and_bills.what: Bill by Rep. Gary Brown (R-Cheyenne) to amend the data center exemption process failed to be considered for introduction; in Sept 2026 the Joint Revenue Committee asked LSO to redraft it and is studying reporting requirements and higher data center taxes
